sharedRules.name: TACTICAL REDEPLOYMENT (2)
sharedRules.description: Select a DWARF COMMAND model in the warband. All DWARF models within 9", including the nominated COMMAND model that are not knocked-down or Engaged, may immediately move up to 3" in any direction, following the normal movement rules. Models are not marked as activated after moving if they are not already. Once any moves are completed, all models that were eligible to move are given a free Brace action (mark them all as such).

sharedRules.name: Spell - Earthquake
sharedRules.description: Each model under the area of the Breath attack must roll a die. If a model rolls equal to or under its Sp stat, it is Knocked-down and must make a single Armour Roll to avoid suffering a wound. Models that have the Steady special rule may re-roll the test against their Sp stat.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Forged Anew
sharedRules.description: Cast on self or target a single friendly model within range, even if it is Engaged. Roll 3D8. For each 7+ rolled, the Ar stat of the target is improved by 1 until the end of the Round. (e.g. 5+ becomes 4+), to a maximum of 3+.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Shieldbreaker Hammer
sharedRules.description: The model may reroll one of its Melee attack dice that failed to cause a hit.

sharedRules.name: Combined Fire (IC)
sharedRules.description: When involved in a Group Shoot Action, Ironwatch models add +1 dice to their Ranged Attack roll if one or more other Ironwatch models in the group fire at the same target.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Battledrill
sharedRules.description: When this model makes a Melee attack (not a Retaliation) with the Battledrill, hits are scored on a 5+ regardless of any modifiers. Every hit scored counts as an exploding 8 result and so another die can be rolled.

sharedRules.name: Cumbersome
sharedRules.description: This model cannot Climb, or be given any kind of Mount.

sharedRules.name: Hammer and Anvil
sharedRules.description: Ironclad models Engaged with the same enemy model as one or more friendly Shieldbreakers, have the Swarm special rule.

sharedRules.name: Combined Fire (DR)
sharedRules.description: When involved in a Group Shoot Action, Dwarf Ranger models (including Ranger Captains) add +1 dice to their Ranged attack roll if one or more other Dwarf Ranger models in the group fire at the same target.

sharedRules.name: Concentrated Fire
sharedRules.description: Once per game, the Flame Priest can take a long action to attack using its Dwarf Flame Thrower with Range 9” and Piercing (2), instead of the normal profile. This will also Fatigue the Flame Priest.

sharedRules.name: Cumbersome
sharedRules.description: This model cannot Climb, or be given any kind of Mount.

sharedRules.name: TREMOR STOMP (2)
sharedRules.description: Spend the Power to make a short action during this model's Turn to create a Shockwave. Use the rules for the Shockwave spell (not the boosted version). This is not considered to be the casting of a spell however. The model can be Engaged but must be standing to use Tremor Stomp. Armour rolls for models forced to move out of contact with the Steel Juggernaut are not required.

sharedRules.name: Bullheaded
sharedRules.description: DWARF models in this warband add +1 to the result when rolling for Headstrong. This means that on a 5+, the Fatigue counter is removed and the model may act as normal.
